verdict.rationale: Edge0's GitHub repo documents running the product entirely on your own hardware. You download models with a fetch script, then run `edge0 serve` to expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on localhost, with native local apps and a daemon across desktop and mobile. This is first-party self-hosting of the core engine. Missing for 10: no stated open-source license or redistribution terms in the evidence, no independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and no server or production deployment guidance (e.g. containers, remote hosting).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
